entities.name: Sydney Emanuel Mudd II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sydney Emanuel Mudd II was an American attorney and politician who served as the U.S. representative for Maryland's 5th congressional district from 1915 until his death in 1924. He was a member of the Republican Party.
